newsitem.title: UK: H&C says DTI looking at dealings in Cantors.
newsitem.headline: H&C says DTI looking at dealings in Cantors.

text.p: H&C Furnishings Plc said on Monday that the UK's Department of Trade and Industry was investigating dealings in the shares of Cantors Plc prior to its merger with Harveys Holdings Plc.
H&C was called Cantors prior to its merger with Harvey Holdings in July 1996 in a deal worth 55.4 million stg.
The DTI told Reuters that it would neither confirm or deny an investigation into a company or an individual.
The company said that it would like to stress that the inquiry is about share dealings and not into the company. "It does not affect the financial stability of the company."
It said it will release interim results on January 28.
